key.name: toggle-popup
key.summary: Show or hide the clipboard popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the clipboard history. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: paste-as-plain
key.summary: Paste the last item as plain text
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that puts the most recent item on the clipboard with formatting removed. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: toggle-private-mode
key.summary: Turn private mode on or off
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that stops and resumes recording of the clipboard. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: history-size
key.description: How many items to keep, not counting favourites and pinned items.

key.name: max-item-size-mb
key.description: Text longer than this is stored truncated.

key.name: max-image-size-mb
key.description: Images larger than this are not stored.

key.name: max-db-size-mb
key.description: When the stored history passes this size the oldest items are removed.

key.name: storage-path
key.description: Full path of the history file. Empty means the default location under the user data directory.

key.name: track-images
key.description: Store images that are copied to the clipboard.

key.name: track-files
key.description: Store file references that are copied from a file manager.

key.name: track-primary-selection
key.description: Also record text that is merely selected, which is what middle click pastes. Off by default because it records a great deal.

key.name: strip-whitespace
key.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from stored text.

key.name: skip-duplicates
key.description: Move an item that is already in the history to the top instead of storing it twice.

key.name: private-mode
key.description: While this is on nothing is recorded, whatever the other settings say.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: Applications whose copies are never recorded. An entry matches the application id, its name or its window class, with or without a .desktop suffix, ignoring case.

key.name: popup-position
key.description: At the pointer, in the middle of the monitor the pointer is on, or anchored to one of its edges or corners.

key.name: popup-at-cursor
key.summary: Open the popup at the pointer
key.description: Replaced by popup-position and only read once, to carry the old choice over. It is not used otherwise.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: Put an item on the clipboard after the pointer rests on it, without a click.

key.name: close-on-paste
key.description: Close the popup once an item has been chosen.

key.name: close-on-click-outside
key.description: Close the popup when the pointer is clicked outside it or another window takes the focus.

key.name: click-outside-grace-ms
key.description: How long after opening the popup ignores clicks outside it, so the click that opened it cannot close it again.

key.name: show-notification
key.description: Show a notification whenever something is added to the history.

key.name: preview-length
key.description: How many characters of an item to show in the list.

key.name: items-per-page
key.description: How many items the popup lists.

key.name: popup-width
key.description: Width before the display scale factor is applied, so the popup is the same physical size on a HiDPI monitor.

key.name: popup-height
key.description: Height before the display scale factor is applied.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show the ClipMaster icon in the top panel.

key.name: indicator-icon
key.description: Name of the symbolic icon to use in the panel.

key.name: follow-system-theme
key.description: Use light or dark Adwaita to match the desktop colour scheme.

key.name: theme
key.description: One of adwaita, catppuccin, dracula, nord, gruvbox, onedark, monokai, solarized, tokyonight, rosepine, material, ayu.

key.name: dark-theme
key.description: Use the dark variant of the chosen theme when the system theme is not being followed.

key.name: custom-theme-path
key.description: Path to a CSS file to load instead of a built-in theme. Empty means use the built-in themes.

key.name: encrypt-database
key.description: Scramble the history file with a repeating-key XOR so that it is not readable at a glance. This is obfuscation, not encryption: the key is stored next to the data, so anyone who can read the file can also recover its contents. Versions up to 1.3.1 described this as AES-256, which was wrong.

key.name: encryption-key
key.description: Generated automatically and also kept in a file beside the history. Do not edit it by hand: the stored history cannot be read back without it.

key.name: custom-lists
key.description: Kept for compatibility with 1.2 and earlier, which stored lists here. Lists now live in the history file.

key.name: pinned-lists
key.description: Identifiers of the lists that get their own button in the popup.

key.name: settings-version
key.description: Set by the extension so that an upgrade can carry old settings over exactly once.

key.name: reload-request
key.description: Raised by the preferences window after it changes the history file, so the running extension reloads it instead of writing its own copy back over the change.

key.name: show-shortcut-hint
key.description: Set during the upgrade to version 2 for a user who was relying on the keyboard shortcut that earlier versions shipped, so they are told once that it is now theirs to choose.

key.name: debug-mode
key.description: Write extra detail to the system journal. Read it with: journalctl -f -o cat /usr/bin/gnome-shell
